thread:
Oliver (Acme): Hey team — we're ready to start the POC. Can you provision a billing project/org for our account, set a hard spend cap at $1,500, and give us ephemeral API keys for integration testing? Also want to test a small Dedicated pool (1xA10G) behind a VPC.

Molly S: Thanks, Oliver — we can do that. Quick checklist so we don't miss anything: 1) billing org + trial credits, 2) spend cap + quota, 3) ephemeral keys for dev, 4) Dedicated pool request + VPC gating, 5) security questionnaire items. I'll coordinate.

Samira (SE): For ephemeral keys we'll create a project-scoped API key with TTL 24h. You can rotate it via our Console or API. Example curl to request a dev key from our side:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/{proj_id}/ephemeral-keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer RESELLER_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"ttl_seconds":86400, "notes":"acme dev key"}'
```

Raj P: For Dedicated pool, we need the target region, GPU type, and expected sustained RPS. 1xA10G is fine for perf tests but if you plan batch throughput please tell us. Also confirm whether VPC peering or Private deployment (customer-managed control plane) is required.

Oliver (Acme): Region is us-west-2. We're doing interactive traffic ~10 rps and a few batch jobs. VPC peering is fine — we don't need on-prem private control plane yet.

Tina F: Re: spend cap — we have two levers: a soft quota (alerting at 80%) and a hard spend cap that blocks tokens once reached. For POC we can provision $1,500 in free credits and set a hard cap at $1,500. Need the customer billing contact to sign the spend cap Acknowledgement (legal). Who is that?

Oliver (Acme): It's me, oliver@acme.com. I can sign. Also question on quotas — can you restrict model family to smaller quantized variants to help with cost?

Samira (SE): Yes — we can apply a per-project model whitelist and a max tokens-per-request quota. Recommend: allow quantized-ggml-* and small-llama-variants. We'll add a policy: max_tokens_per_minute=15000 for the project.

Molly S: Action items: 1) Tina to create billing project and apply $1,500 trial credits + hard cap; 2) Raj to open Dedicated pool request for 1xA10G in us-west-2 and attach VPC peering ticket; 3) Samira to create ephemeral key and apply model whitelist + token quota; 4) Oliver to sign spend cap ack. I'll follow up with links and ETA.

Tina F: Starting billing project now. ETA ~2 hours to provision credits and enforce cap. I'll DM the agreement for signature.

Raj P: I'll file the infra ticket for Dedicated + VPC peering. Please provide your VPC CIDR and the AWS account id.

Oliver (Acme): VPC CIDR 10.10.0.0/16, AWS acct 123456789012.

Samira (SE): Created ephemeral key (ttl 24h) and shared it in a secure DM to Oliver. Also applied the model whitelist and token quota. Please validate integration and ping if you need longer TTL.

Oliver (Acme): Got the key and the credits show up in console. Trying the integration now. Thanks! :tada:

Molly S: Great — once you validate, we'll kick off the Dedicated provisioning. If you hit any quota or billing blocker, ping this thread.

Oliver (Acme): Small follow-up: the security questionnaire asked about logging retention for VPC peering. Can you confirm logs are retained for 90 days?

Raj P: Yes — we can enable VPC flow logs to deliver to your CloudWatch/S3 and set retention 90d. I'll add the log configuration to the peering ticket.

Tina F: All set on billing side. You should see transactional emails for the spend cap ack.

Oliver (Acme): Received and signed. 

Molly S: Awesome — moving to close the loop. We'll update the Dedicated ticket after infra completes. Tagging next steps: @Raj P to update status by EOD; @Samira (SE) to upload simple example integration into the shared repo.

Samira (SE): Will do, I'll push a quick Node + curl example to the repo.

Oliver (Acme): Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Molly S: :thumbsup: closing for now, reopen if anything else comes up.
